title: gentiana aquatica var. baltistanica
intro: Gentiana aquatica var. baltistanica, commonly known as Baltistan gentian, is a rare and endangered plant species belonging to the gentian family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Baltistan gentian include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as a natural remedy for various respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, gentiacauleine, and gentiogenin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
